Input:  {base}/profiling_output_n500_bf16_{ds,qw}_{imp,rand}_s{015,020,025,030}/profiling_results.json

"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

PHASES = ["high", "mid", "low"]

SEED = 42

N_BONFERRONI = 4  # 4 sparsity levels per model

    fpath = dirpath / "profiling_results.json"
    if not fpath.exists():
        return None
    with open(fpath) as f:
        return json.load(f)


def get_problems(data: dict) -> Optional[List[dict]]:
    ppi = data.get("per_problem_ii", {})
    levels = list(ppi.keys())
    if not levels:
        return None
    return ppi[levels[0]]

    report = {"label": label, "status": "OK", "warnings": [], "errors": []}

    config_n = data.get("config", {}).get("n_problems", None)
    problems = get_problems(data)
    if not problems:
        report["status"] = "ERROR"
        report["errors"].append("No per_problem_ii data found")
        return report

    if actual_n != expected_n:
        report["errors"].append(f"Expected {expected_n} problems, got {actual_n}")
        report["status"] = "ERROR"

    if config_n is not None and config_n != expected_n:
        report["warnings"].append(f"Config n_problems={config_n}, expected {expected_n}")

            non_monotonic.append((i, indices[i - 1], indices[i]))

            report["status"] = "WARNING"

            f"Possible duplicate-process contamination."

    duplicates = {k: v for k, v in pid_counts.items() if v > 1}
